ai_summary: ADF Foods Limited has issued a routine regulatory announcement regarding its upcoming Q2 & H1 FY27 earnings call, scheduled for November 6th, 2026, at 3:30 PM IST. This document serves to inform stakeholders of the event, providing access details and confirming management participants, including the Chairman, MD, and CFO. There are no direct material financial impacts or red flags contained within this procedural notification, as it solely announces the future discussion of financial results, rather than presenting them.
